documentation.cara_kerja: Fetch ESG ratings dari MSCI/Sustainalytics public data, agregasi per sektor, hitung trend analysis (YoY improvement/deterioration), dan identifikasi ESG leaders vs laggards.
documentation.fungsi: Dashboard ESG scores per perusahaan/sektor: Environmental (carbon, waste), Social (labor, diversity), Governance (board, ethics). Alert untuk significant rating changes.
documentation.tujuan: Investor dan compliance officers yang perlu monitor ESG performance untuk sustainable investing mandates dan regulatory reporting.
